weekLabel: Week of Aug 16 to Aug 23 · refreshed Sunday Aug 16. Tap a source to confirm before you go.

events.name: Riverfest at Salisbury Beach
events.meta: Free · Broadway Boardwalk, Salisbury Beach · 24th annual, run by 92.5 The River. Spin Doctors at 4:30, Buffalo Tom at 3:00, Fantastic Cat at 1:30. Free music on the sand all afternoon, then fireworks over the water at 10:15. Special event parking is $40 until 6pm, so go early or park off the boardwalk and walk in. source

events.when: Fri Aug 21 4pm, Sat Aug 22 12pm, Sun Aug 23
events.name: San Gennaro Feast
events.meta: Free entry · Paul Revere Mall (The Prado), 4 Unity St, North End · North End street feast: 30+ food vendors, DJ sets, a Motown tribute Friday night and Russell Thompkins Jr. & The New Stylistics Saturday at 8:30. Take the Orange Line to Haymarket, North End parking is a losing game. source

events.name: Patriots preseason vs Eagles
events.meta: Ticketed · Gillette Stadium, 1 Patriot Place, Foxborough · Second and final home preseason game before the season opens. The Dave and Alex play. source

events.name: Revolution vs New York City FC
events.meta: Ticketed, parking is free · Gillette Stadium, 1 Patriot Place, Foxborough · Lots open 2:30, gates 3:30. Cheaper and easier than the NFL, and Patriot Place gives you somewhere to eat before kickoff. source

events.name: 43rd Annual Seacoast Jazz Festival
events.meta: $20 suggested donation, nobody turned away · Prescott Park, 105 Marcy St, Portsmouth NH · All-afternoon waterfront jazz on the Wilcox Main Stage. Pair it with a walk through Portsmouth and food on the water. source

events.name: Culture Splash on Rocky Neck
events.meta: Free · Rocky Neck Art Colony, 51 Rocky Neck Ave, Gloucester · Sixth season. Gallery openings, artist demos, live music and waterfront dining, with a free water shuttle from Solomon's Landing and St. Peter's Square. The shuttle is the whole reason to go. source

events.name: Madi Diaz with Abrielle Scharff
events.meta: $20 suggested donation · Prescott Park, 105 Marcy St, Portsmouth NH · Waterfront outdoor show, blankets on the grass. Food can be pre-ordered from Ohana Kitchen, Mamma Luca or Laney & Lu. source

events.name: SoWa Open Market
events.meta: Free entry · 500 Harrison Ave, Boston · The standing city Sunday: 100+ makers, farmers market, food trucks, vintage. Easy to walk to a coffee or juice stop first. source

events.name: St. Anthony's Feast
events.meta: Free · Endicott, Thatcher and North Margin Streets, North End · 107th year and the biggest Italian feast in New England. The 10-hour Grand Procession starts Sunday Aug 30 at 11:30am on Endicott St. No tickets exist, anyone selling them is a scam. source

events.name: The Devil Makes Three with The Wolff Sisters
events.meta: $20 suggested donation · Prescott Park, Portsmouth NH · Reserve a spot ahead if you want a real patch of lawn, this one fills. source

events.name: Topsfield Fair
events.meta: Ticketed (price verify) · 207 Boston St, Topsfield · America's oldest county fair, 30 minutes away. Buy online ahead and go on a weekday if you can. source

events.name: Salem Haunted Happenings
events.meta: Mixed, much of it free (individual event costs verify) · Downtown Salem · 500,000+ visitors across October. If you want a specific weekend, lock in parking and any ticketed events now, not in September. source
